query: What data governance, de-identification, and release policies best preserve clinically relevant visual cues while enabling reproducibility (which artifacts, licensing, synthetic/masked benchmarks, and ethical approvals to include)?

response.query: What data governance, de-identification, and release policies best preserve clinically relevant visual cues while enabling reproducibility (which artifacts, licensing, synthetic/masked benchmarks, and ethical approvals to include)?
response.answer: Data governance should include strict de-identification protocols, synthetic benchmarks, and ethical approvals. Release policies must preserve clinically relevant visual cues while ensuring reproducibility. Licensing must comply with relevant regulations.
